question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for:
"The sound of the funeral bell."
solution:
The correct answer is: **Knell**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Knell"** refers to the sound of a bell, especially when rung solemnly for a funeral or as a signal of death or disaster. (शोक घंटी)
 
 
• **Example:** The knell of the church bell echoed through the village as the funeral procession began.
 
 
• **"Knell"** is often used metaphorically to signify the end of something or a warning of impending doom. (शोक संकेत)
 
 
• **Example:** The announcement of the company's bankruptcy was the death knell for thousands of employees.
 
 
• Hence, the word **"Knell"** appropriately captures the meaning of "The sound of the funeral bell."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Knell**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Toll** (टोल): Refers to the act of ringing a bell, especially for marking the passage of time or signaling an event, but not specifically a funeral bell.
 
 
• **Example:** The toll of the bell marked the beginning of the ceremony.
 
 
 
• **Ring** (घंटी बजना): Refers to any general sound made by a bell or similar object.
 
 
• **Example:** The ring of the doorbell alerted us to the arrival of guests.
 
 
 
• **Echo** (गूंज): Refers to the repetition of a sound caused by reflection of sound waves, not specific to a bell or funeral.
 
 
• **Example:** The echo of her laughter filled the empty halls.

सही उत्तर है: **नेल**।
